prompt-misinterpretation: Orchestrator or agent misread the user's intent, scope, or an explicit instruction.
stat-methodology: Wrong statistical test, model, normalization, or adjustment choice.
literature-error: A literature claim was missed, misquoted, or overstated relative to the source.
data-integration-error: Wrong merge, harmonization, or normalization when combining datasets.
cohort-selection: Cohort/sample inclusion, exclusion, or sizing was inadequate for the intended comparison.
method-choice: A simpler/more appropriate method existed but a more complex or inappropriate one was used instead.
